NEAR already pays back 11.8% of what it mints. Break-even is 8.5x away.

10.9% is NEAR bought with NEAR Intents fee revenue and 0.92% is gas fees burnt. A fee-burn dashboard sees only the second number and puts break-even 109x away.

Mint, burn and the buyback balance are read from NEAR mainnet, 2026-07-08 to 2026-11-12 (421 epochs, heights 206034734 to 224221936). Mint and burn are exact to the yoctoNEAR. Rebuild with python3 run.py: no keys, no network.

Not enough history with buyback data for a trend yet.
